- **Posting reconciliation** – Reconcile transaction‑db postings against fraud‑engine screening outcomes; ensure blocked sixth attempts and declined attempts are recorded completely and immutably (SOX) [fraud‑engine, transaction‑db]

- **Service‑owner approvals & release coordination** – Obtain Payments Platform and Core Banking approvals for the fraud‑engine change; record the rollback plan and agreed core‑payments release ordering shared with ST‑101 (Internal Governance) [fraud‑engine]  
- **Operational monitoring & alerting** – Verify monitoring, alerting, and authorization tests for the new velocity rule, together with evidence of the combined ST‑101/ST‑110 regression run (Internal Governance) [fraud‑engine, risk‑engine, transaction‑db]  
- **Dependency sign‑off** – Confirm documented ownership sign‑off for the risk‑engine policy‑signal dependency and for the downstream transaction‑db posting path (Internal Governance) [risk‑engine, transaction‑db]
